title: S6 'switch hotels, partner joining' — LIVE NL intake (occupancy/property extraction) + RECORD Nuitée occupancy-aware hotel.search

boundaries.note: natural-language hotel-switch request interpreted by LIVE Model Studio into the frozen ChangeRequest schema (guests + quoted replacement property), zod-validated
occupancy-aware hotel.search through the RECORD-mode Nuitée adapter; sanitized recordings persisted

steps.description: Traveller asks in natural language to switch hotels with partner occupancy; LIVE Model Studio extracts CHANGE_STAY with guests and the quoted replacement property

body.text: Can I switch hotels? My partner is joining, so there will be 2 of us staying. I'd like to move to place-hotel-harbourline. I will self-fund the extra cost.

assert.description: the NL hotel-switch request is accepted
the request came from interpretation, not a pre-structured target
the model classifies the hotel switch as a stay change
a courteous ask carries preference authority, never binding instruction
a recovery case opens for the request
the quoted replacement property becomes an authoritative stay preference
the partner's occupancy is extracted from the text, not defaulted

assert.expected: funding declaration TRAVELLER_FUNDED recorded; no temporal anchor derivable from target
assert.description: funding stays honest: with no cost anchor the allocation is deferred to authority, never assumed

assert.expected: funding allocation UNKNOWN: no temporal anchor in target
assert.description: the missing funding anchor is recorded as UNKNOWN, never converted into certainty

steps.description: Planning loop issues the occupancy-aware hotel.search (RECORD Nuitée evidence) for the quoted replacement property's location and records stay-change status honestly

assert.description: the planning loop runs an evidence round and a concluding round
the declared stay change drives a real hotel.search evidence request
the RECORD Nuitée adapter supplied hotel-market evidence
live hotel-market evidence flows through normalization with property and rate counts
no replacement strategy is fabricated: without a supported strategy path the planner proposes nothing
every stay-change limitation is recorded as explicit uncertainty

assert.expected: hotel replacement strategies are not proposed until hotel.search evidence exists
assert.description: the evidence-gated strategy boundary is stated honestly
the declared property preference is recorded, not silently dropped
the partner occupancy is recorded, not defaulted away
the case remains open in PLANNING — stay-change execution is not silently performed

steps.description: Observe the recovery case after planning

assert.description: the case belongs to the requesting traveller's trip
